q_001.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' COLLATE NOCASE;

q_002.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM loan WHERE status = 'A';

q_003.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS owner_disp_count FROM disp WHERE type = 'OWNER';

q_004.sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(payments), 2) AS avg_monthly_payment
FROM loan;

q_005.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_clients
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND district.A11 > 10000;

q_006.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS owner_count
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND di.A3 = 'Prague' COLLATE NOCASE;

q_007.sql:
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM trans
WHERE account_id = 1
  AND date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31';

q_008.sql:
SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT dp.client_id) AS owner_count
FROM disp dp
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'south Moravia' COLLATE NOCASE
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY owner_count DESC;

q_009.sql:
SELECT d.client_id,
       c.gender,
       SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
GROUP BY d.client_id, c.gender
ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

q_010.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id AND c.gender = 'M'
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id AND di.A3 = 'north Bohemia' COLLATE NOCASE
WHERE l.status = 'C';
